activity.notes: Anawrahta (also rendered Aniruddha and in extended royal-name forms such as Anawrahta Minsaw) ruled the Pagan/Bagan kingdom from 1044 to 1077. He is conventionally treated as the major eleventh-century ruler under whom Bagan expanded into the dominant polity of Upper Myanmar. ATLAS uses the historical polity Pagan Kingdom rather than a modern Myanmar/Burma state label.

sources.title: Political and Economic Development of Myanmar: An Overview — Myanmar in ASEAN
sources.citation_text: Cambridge's overview identifies King Anawrahta of Bagan and gives his reign as 1044-77, placing his rule at the beginning of major Bagan political expansion.

sources.title: Ta Mok Shwe-Gu-Gyi Temple Kyaukse and Bagan — Bagan and the World
sources.citation_text: The archaeological study dates King Anawrahta's reign to 1044-77 CE and discusses material evidence associated with his Bagan-period expansion into Kyaukse.
